I also felt a heightened sense of well being, which lasted most of the day. I was way less anxious, and more optimistic. I would highly recommend this product for anyone who wants to improve their performance both on and off the playing field.

review: As a writer (and a "sometimes" visual art hobbyist, as well), I love Create capsules for kind of loosening up my mind, my associations, and letting go of judgment. I can give myself over the the process of writing, knowing that first drafts aren’t about perfection, which is something that I’ve struggled with in the past. Create also seems to be a shortcut sometimes to a state of "flow"–something we all love, whether we think of ourselves as artistic or scientifically creative or imaginative or daydreamers… It’s something you can bring into your life to illuminate everything and experience the familiar in new ways.

Illuminate capsules really open up my perception. I feel more attuned to my own energy, regardless of whether its tension, peaceful flow, or anything in between; and I find that through breathing and visualizations with eyes closed, I can much more effectively guide my energy toward lightness, compassion (for myself and others), and more. Two things I’d emphasize about Illuminate and also Elevate capsules (mini doses) is: 1) Stay away from screens–it zaps the power of these amazing tools, and 2) Don’t view them as a way to "escape" a bad or painful mood; they are tools of exploration, uncovering, truth. They might bring you a deeper into your pain so that you gain the clarity you need to adjust your perspective. This isn’t about a "high" or escapism; it’s about traveling through the self, perception, emotion, and more, seeing things for new angles and oftentimes grabbing the reins and steering towards more productive, imaginative, and beautiful ways of seeing life and the world.

Microdosing alongside a community has proven more beneficial than dosing alone. I started my journey with the 30 Day Experience back in November, and just finished the May cohort (as my second time with this experience). I dosed on the months in between these two cohorts and while I found it very liberating to journey alone, the support and guidance that I gained through the 30 Day Experience Program expedited any inner work that I could do alone. You not only have a compassionate and safe space to be in, you also have guidance when you ask for it. Gaining that external perspective of yourself is truly what has led me into faster healing, greater connection to myself and everyone around me, and bringing me closer to my intentions that I set with dosing. I’ll definitely be joining another cohort in the future!
